entities.summary: Tina Barney is an American photographer best known for her large-scale, color portraits of her family and close friends in New York and New England. She is a member of the Lehman family. Tina Barney was a painters & sculptors from New York City (b. 1945, New York City). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
